name: OpenWrt Internet Latency Charts
description: Live internet latency and 1h / 24h / 7d charts, measured from TrueNAS
template:
<Stack gap="sm">
  <Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>Internet Latency</Text><RefreshButton size="xs" /></Group>
  {status.snapshot?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red">Latency collector unavailable</Alert> : !data.snapshot ? <Text size="sm">Waiting for latency data...</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Measured from TrueNAS collector, not directly from OpenWrt</Text>
    <SimpleGrid cols={2} spacing="xs">{(data.snapshot.targets ?? []).map((t) => <Paper key={t.target} p="xs" withBorder><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{t.target}</Text><Text fw={700} size="lg">{t.lastMs ?? "N/A"} ms</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Avg {t.avgMs ?? "N/A"} ms · Loss {t.lossPct ?? "N/A"}%</Text></Paper>)}</SimpleGrid>
    <SegmentedControl bind="range" defaultValue="1h" size="xs" data={[{label:"1 hour",value:"1h"},{label:"24 hours",value:"24h"},{label:"7 days",value:"7d"}]} />
    {((inputs.range ?? "1h") === "1h" ? data.h1 : (inputs.range === "24h" ? data.h24 : data.d7))?.points?.length > 0 ?
      <LineChart h={220} data={((inputs.range ?? "1h") === "1h" ? data.h1 : (inputs.range === "24h" ? data.h24 : data.d7)).points} dataKey="time" series={[{name:"ping1",color:"blue.6",label:"1.1.1.1"},{name:"ping2",color:"green.6",label:"8.8.8.8"}]} curveType="linear" connectNulls={false} withLegend withTooltip yAxisProps={{domain:[0,"auto"]}} /> : <Alert color="gray">No latency history in this interval yet.</Alert>}
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Successful pings averaged per minute (1h), 15 minutes (24h), or hour (7d). Gaps are not zero latency.</Text>
  </Stack>}
</Stack>
